subject: Compact KPI brief + two quick asks after POC

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact KPI brief + two quick asks after POC

Hi Ellis / Harper —

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with us. I pulled together a very short one-page brief (attached) with the metrics we tracked during the run. High level:

- Mean inference latency fell from ~310ms -> ~120ms (about 62% improvement) for your peak query set.
- Estimated inference spend per 1k requests dropped ~41% once batching & prefix cache were enabled.
- Peak burst throughput improved ~3x on the same hardware profile (reduced queueing during 30-min traffic spikes).

We have two quick asks if MarketMall is open to them:
1) A 1–2 sentence quote we can use in a short case highlight (we can suggest wording and you can edit). Example ask: one line about the ROI/ops impact.
2) A quick 10–15 minute recorded call to capture a 20–30s soundbite we could pair with the quote (we'll record, send for approval, and only publish after sign-off).

If you both are fine with those, we also want permission to use MarketMall's name & logo (logo only in the case highlight, not in any paid marketing). If there are limits on what we can publish (anonymized numbers, no logos, etc.) just tell us and we'll follow your guidance.

Proposed times (PST): Thu 5/23 10:00–10:15, Thu 5/23 14:00–14:15, Fri 5/24 09:00–09:15. If those don't work, tell me two times that do and we'll send a calendar invite.

Attached: marketmall-poc-kpi-brief.pdf and a perf dashboard snapshot (PNG).

Thanks — really appreciate you partnering on this.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap and for running the brief. The numbers look right from our side; the latency drop and the cost delta match what we measured on our telemetry. We're happy to help with a short quote and the quick call.

Two small constraints: please do not publish per-user-level logs (obviously), and if you include percentages in marketing copy, please note them as POC results (don’t imply company-wide rollout unless we both sign off later). Otherwise feel free to reference MarketMall and use our logo.

Suggested one-liner (feel free to edit):
"Redwood's platform reduced inference latency and cut inference costs materially during our POC, allowing us to support peak traffic without infrastructure changes."

Availability: Thu 5/23 14:00 PST works for Harper and me. If you want the 10–15 minute window, please schedule the calendar invite and we’ll approve the final recording.
